operations.title: How gravity was discovered
operations.caption: From a falling apple to a law that reaches the Moon: the same pull that drops an apple holds the Moon in its orbit, and Newton's inverse-square law generalises it to all masses.
operations.narration: The story of gravity's discovery runs as a chain. It starts with the falling apple — the everyday pull toward Earth. Newton's leap was to see the Moon as perpetually falling, kept in orbit by the same force. That force weakens with the square of distance, and the inverse-square law, checked against the Moon's motion, becomes universal gravitation — one law for the apple and the planets alike.

from manim import *

class GeneratedScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # ---- Title ----
        title = Text("Newton's Apple", font_size=44, color=WHITE)
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.4)

        # ---- Ground plane (oblique 3D perspective) ----
        ground = Polygon(
            [-6.8, -2.6, 0], [6.8, -2.6, 0], [7.4, -1.3, 0], [-6.2, -1.3, 0],
            fill_color=GREEN_E, fill_opacity=0.35, stroke_color=GREEN_D,
            stroke_width=2,
        )
        ground_line = Line([-6.8, -2.6, 0], [6.8, -2.6, 0], color=GREEN_D, stroke_width=3)

        # ---- Tree ----
        trunk = Line([4.5, -2.6, 0], [4.5, 2.2, 0], color="#8B5A2B", stroke_width=10)
        branch = Line([4.5, 2.2, 0], [2.6, 2.9, 0], color="#8B5A2B", stroke_width=6)
        foliage1 = Circle(radius=1.0, color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.9).move_to([4.5, 3.1, 0])
        foliage2 = Circle(radius=0.7, color=GREEN_B, fill_opacity=0.9).move_to([3.5, 3.4, 0])
        foliage3 = Circle(radius=0.6, color=GREEN_C, fill_opacity=0.9).move_to([5.3, 3.3, 0])
        tree = VGroup(trunk, branch, foliage1, foliage2, foliage3)

        # ---- Newton stick figure (facing right) ----
        head = Circle(radius=0.28, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1.0).move_to([-4.5, -1.15, 0])
        body = Line([-4.5, -1.45, 0], [-4.5, -2.2, 0], color=WHITE, stroke_width=5)
        leg1 = Line([-4.5, -2.2, 0], [-4.7, -2.6, 0], color=WHITE, stroke_width=5)
        leg2 = Line([-4.5, -2.2, 0], [-4.3, -2.6, 0], color=WHITE, stroke_width=5)
        arm = Line([-4.5, -1.5, 0], [-3.95, -1.0, 0], color=WHITE, stroke_width=5)
        newton = VGroup(head, body, leg1, leg2, arm)

        # ---- Labels ----
        newton_label = Text("Newton", font_size=30, color=WHITE).next_to(newton, DOWN, buff=0.15)
        apple_label = Text("apple", font_size=28, color=RED).move_to([2.6, 3.4, 0])

        # ---- Apple fall path ----
        def apple_pos(t):
            x = 2.6 - 1.0 * t
            y = 2.9 - 6.5 * t + 1.0 * t * t
            return np.array([x, y, 0])

        path = ParametricFunction(apple_pos, t_range=[0, 1], color=YELLOW)

        progress = ValueTracker(0)
        apple = always_redraw(
            lambda: Dot(apple_pos(progress.get_value()), radius=0.16, color=RED, fill_opacity=1.0)
        )
        trail = TracedPath(
            lambda: apple.get_center(),
            stroke_width=4,
            stroke_color=YELLOW,
            stroke_opacity=0.8,
        )
        trail.set_dashed(True)

        # ---- Reveal ----
        self.play(FadeIn(title), run_time=1.0)
        self.play(FadeIn(ground), Create(ground_line), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(tree), FadeIn(newton), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(newton_label), FadeIn(apple_label), run_time=1.0)
        self.wait(0.5)

        self.add(trail)
        self.play(
            progress.animate.set_value(1.0),
            rate_func=linear,
            run_time=4.0,
        )
        self.wait(1.5)
